title: Man’s Claim That Brakes Failed on Jaguar Was Scam to Avoid Car Payments, Court Rules
summary_full: Nathan Owen called the police, saying he was trapped in a runaway car. A judge determined it was a lie and sentenced him to more than four years in prison.
